action_items: Assistant replies are MOCKED deterministic local UI responses by design; no external AI provider integration was tested.

Backend pytest suite completed with no tests collected; no API-bearing acceptance criterion required a backend artifact in this matrix. The template status endpoint remains outside the tested UI flow.

checks.criterion: TODO AI workspace renders at the public preview root
checks.name: todo-ai-preview-renders
checks.evidence: Root rendered todo-ai-app, TODO AI brand, chat heading, sidebar navigation, composer form, and AI tools rail; screenshot captured.

checks.criterion: New chat and suggested prompts work
checks.name: todo-ai-suggestions-reset-chat
checks.evidence: Suggested prompt produced a user message and planning assistant reply; New chat restored the starter assistant state and suggestions.

checks.name: todo-ai-composer-sends-message
checks.evidence: Filled composer with a unique message, submitted via send control, observed user message, MOCKED assistant reply, thinking indicator, and cleared input.

checks.name: todo-ai-tool-shortcut-prefills-composer
checks.evidence: Smart Translator card selected; composer value became 'Smart Translator: ' and visible toast confirmed selection.

checks.criterion: Theme and responsive navigation controls work
checks.name: todo-ai-theme-toggle
checks.evidence: Theme button toggled Light mode to Dark mode and back without breaking the workspace.

checks.criterion: Theme and responsive navigation controls work
checks.name: todo-ai-mobile-navigation
checks.evidence: At 390x844 viewport, Open navigation displayed the sidebar close control; close returned to the mobile menu control.

checks.criterion: Public preview has no failed requests or console errors during the core flow
checks.name: todo-ai-core-flow-no-errors
checks.evidence: Core prompt, tool, and theme flow completed with no response status >= 400 and no console error messages observed.
